title: fix(plugin-charts): an object-bound chart that names its category with aggregate.groupBy alone draws it (objectui#10634)
body:
Fixes #10634
Clause-②: no — an object-bound chart begins honouring `aggregate.groupBy` as its category, as the objectui#8168 remedy already names; no export, schema or accept set moves.

## What changed

An object-bound `object-chart` with `objectName` + `aggregate: { field: 'amount', function: 'sum', groupBy: 'stage' }` + `series` and no `xAxisKey` / `xAxis` passed the objectui#8168 absent-category screen (`resolveChartCategoryField` accepts `groupBy`), and was then refused one layer down with `missing-category-key`: the schema `ObjectChart` handed `ChartRenderer` carried no category key, so `AdvancedChartImpl` floored it on `'name'`.

`ObjectChart` now forwards the category column when the author named it only through `groupBy` (`groupByCategoryKey` in `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx`):

- **Which key.** The COLUMN the aggregate projects its group under: `aggregateGroupByKey` (the `groupBy` string, or `alias || field` for the structured node). That is the contract's result-column convention (`chartAggregateCategoryKey` / `chartAggregateResultKeys` in `@objectstack/spec/ui`), the same key `groupByField` already relabels and drills by, and the column the dashboard relays bind (objectui#8269).
- **When.** Only to fill an absent slot, and only on the path the screen guards. The screen and the forward now read ONE predicate, `drawsFetchedObjectRows` (`objectName`, no `dataset`, no authored `data` / `bind` rows). The screen's boolean is byte-for-byte the same value. "Absent" is asked of `normalizeChartSchema`, the package's one translation of `xAxisKey` / `xAxis.field` / bare string `xAxis`, not of `schema.xAxisKey` alone.
- **Unchanged.** An authored category axis always wins, and nothing is written over one. The dataset path takes the other arm of `finalSchema`. Charts drawing authored rows are untouched, with or without `objectName`.

## Zone 2 hypotheses, measured

- **H1 reproduced on base.** The groupBy-only node gives screen absent + `missing-category-key` (`AssertionError: expected 'missing-category-key' to be null`). The `xAxisKey: 'stage'` control draws. The `groupBy: { field }` form is refused the same way on base.
- **H2 partly falsified: the key source.** The order read "set the category key from `resolveChartCategoryField(schema)`". That resolver answers the FIELD (its structured leg returns `groupBy.field`), and `chartCategoryKey`'s docblock in `@object-ui/core` records that it must not be conflated with the COLUMN. Its precedence is also not "authored xAxisKey over xAxis.field over groupBy". It ranks `groupBy` FIRST, pinned by `prefers a structured GroupBy node field over every other spelling`. The rule implemented is fill-only-absent: the renderer's own resolution (`xAxisKey`, then `xAxis.field`, then bare string `xAxis`) answers first, and the groupBy column is used only when it answers nothing. Ablation A2 below shows the field source re-refusing the alias node.
- **H3 column name.** It is the raw `groupBy` (`stage`), or `alias ?? field` for the structured node, per `chartAggregateResultKeys`. Read on the adapter too: `data-objectstack` `aggregate()` sends `dimensions: [groupBy]` on the analytics wire, and its client-side fallback keys `{ [groupBy]: key, [valueKey]: result }`. The structured wire returns the engine's `alias ?? field` column.
- **H4 pins.** New file `ObjectChart.groupByCategoryForward-10634.test.tsx`, 9 tests, every assertion read from the drawn DOM (ticks, marks, `data-chart-error`).
- **H5 prose.** Nothing falsified. I read `.changeset/8168-…` (its remedy is now true), `8269-…`, `8266-…`, `10518-…`, `8613-…`, `objectchart-schema-anchor-7946`, and the four `check:changeset-claims` hits. `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx` and the package README describe the inline-data `chart` / `bar-chart` nodes only, so no page documents the object-chart aggregate binding. No dated note was owed.

## Red then green

Base = `f99f9cde7` (`ObjectChart.tsx` at base, pins at head). Head = `92852954b`.

| Pin | base | head |
|---|---|---|
| string `groupBy`, no `xAxisKey` / `xAxis` (the card's node) | red: `missing-category-key` | green: 2 marks, ticks `won`/`lost` |
| control: `xAxisKey: 'stage'` | green | green |
| structured `groupBy: { field }` | red | green |
| structured node with `alias` binds the aliased column | red | green |
| forwarded key survives the groupBy label rewrite (ticks are option labels) | red | green |
| authored `xAxisKey` wins over the groupBy column | green | green |
| authored `xAxis: { field }` wins over the groupBy column | green | green |
| object-bound node with authored `data` keeps its own category | green | green |
| static-data node keeps its own category | green | green |

Base run: `Tests  4 failed | 5 passed (9)`.

## Per-hunk ablation

Each leg ran through `ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor hit once, the blob changed, and the restore was proven: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

- A1: delete the `finalSchema` spread. The same 4 pins go red as on base.
- A2: key source changed to `resolveChartCategoryField(schema)` (the FIELD). Only the alias pin goes red, with `missing-category-key`.
- A3: absent-test reads `!schema.xAxisKey` alone. Only the `xAxis: { field }` pin goes red (ticks `won`/`lost` instead of `ann`/`bob`).
- A4: drop `!hasAuthoredRows` from the shared predicate. The authored-`data` pin goes red here, and so does the objectui#8168 sweep-fixture pin.

## Gates (final head `92852954b`)

Every run below is on head `92852954b`. Test and build runs went through `os-verify-lock.sh`.

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-charts^...' run build`: EXIT 0 (dependency closure: types, core, i18n, react, components, data-objectstack, react-runtime, sdui-parser).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): EXIT 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new pin file (count 1), so the test config does type-check it.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-charts/`: `Test Files  77 passed (77)` / `Tests  856 passed (856)`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: `✅  2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: `✅  No changeset declares a major bump`.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s), enforcement report-only, exit 0`.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: `✅  check-control-bytes: OK`. A separate control-byte grep over the 3 touched files found none.
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims`: exit 0 (report-only). It named 4 pending changesets that mention `ObjectChart.tsx` (8650, 8885 drilldown, 5444 humanize, 7946 anchor). I read each paragraph, and none is falsified.
- `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:i18n-keys`: all exit 0 with their OK lines.
- Governed surface: `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 3 paths answered `✅ NOT GOVERNED`.
- Lint, narrowed and declared (`pnpm lint` is run by CI). I ran `eslint --format json` over the 2 touched TS files: 2 files, 0 errors. `ObjectChart.tsx` has the same warning counts per rule on base and on head (7 only-export-components, 25 no-explicit-any, 2 set-state-in-effect, 1 exhaustive-deps). The new test file adds 2 no-explicit-any warnings, in the same `recharts` mock shim its sibling pins use. The population comes from `eslint.config.js`, which applies `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']` through the package's `eslint .`. The config uses `tseslint.configs.recommended` with no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and no custom rule reads other files. This diff therefore cannot change any verdict on an untouched file.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree` of HEAD against origin/main `0c3f70aae` exits 0, and so does HEAD against the objectui#10635 head `1a89050c2`. Main has not moved in `packages/plugin-charts` since base.

## Acceptance notes

- **Precedence tension, recorded and not changed.** objectui#8269 made the dashboard relays let the aggregate's `groupBy` column win over an authored `xField`. At this layer an authored `xAxisKey` / `xAxis.field` still wins, per the order's "⛔ don't write into a user-authored key". A directly authored node whose `xAxisKey` differs from its `groupBy` still draws `missing-category-key`, and that refusal names the key the author wrote. No card is owed: the diagnostic names the right cause.
- **Observation, not filed.** On the no-`aggregate()` data-source leg, `aggregateRecords` buckets raw records on the group COLUMN, so a structured node's `alias` indexes a record field that does not exist. It also does no date bucketing. This leg's code is untouched here, but the forward makes it draw a mis-bucketed picture for an `alias` or `dateGranularity` node where it was refused before; filed as objectui#10676.
- **Docs.** No docs page describes the object-chart aggregate binding (AGENTS.md #2), so there was nothing to update.

The session that implemented this is `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`.
